title: Ancient temples dismantled and items removed

tellings.quote: certain ancient temples that have been dismantled and things that have been removed and I have found very very compelling evidence that that it's happened

plain: Some ancient temples in the region of Lake Van in eastern Turkey were taken apart, and objects were taken out of them. A researcher named Matt LaCroix tells Michels this without naming a source, saying he has found "very very compelling evidence" that it happened. He raises it in a talk about something big that he says happened around 12,000 BC, and if true it would mean someone has been removing or hiding evidence of that distant past.
